evidence_spans: Our first-principles calculations reveal that AgBr has an indirect optical gap, with a binding energy of ∼135 meV for the lowest-energy bright exciton.
Our first-principles calculations reveal that AgBr has an indirect optical gap, with a binding energy of ∼135 meV for the lowest-energy bright exciton.
CLM-MAT-0472.statement: Our first-principles calculations indicate that face-centered cubic AgBr has a binding energy of approximately 135 meV for its lowest-energy bright exciton.

extra_quotes: We present LetzElPhC, an open-source software package that computes electron-phonon matrix elements from the output of density functional perturbation theory calculations performed with the Quantum ESPRESSO code.

The electron-phonon matrix elements were computed using LetzElPhC, while the GW-BSE calculations were performed using Yambo on a Γ-centered 48 × 48 × 1 k-point grid, with the plasmon-pole approximation [94].
At large process counts, the workload per process decreases, and MPI communication becomes increasingly significant, leading to deviations from ideal scaling.
